Explore.Marker.doc: Gold quest-tracker ring on the island map (tracking must be on). At a screen edge it points to an off-screen target and tapping it pans the camera there; on the map, tapping it walks to the target. Excludes the top bar, minimap and the tracker/chat strip. Two templates: bright (on the lit map) and dim (in shadow or under the level badge). A third template is the white edge pointer used for boss targets (Guardian Colossi).

Explore.Progress.doc: Progress line on the quest tracker panel, e.g. 'Explore Originisle II 37/100'. The panel grows upward when it shows rewards, so the region is tall.

Explore.Complete.doc: Tracker panel showing a finished quest (n/n, e.g. 100/100 or 1/1; a gift icon appears); tap the panel to claim.

Explore.MarkerAnywhere.doc: Same ring anywhere on screen, including under the top bar or tracker panel; used to pan the camera when Explore.Marker can't see it.

Explore.GuardBracket.doc: Top-right of the gold corner brackets drawn around monsters that guard a target (e.g. two Chaosborn guarding the Pink Bird on Originisle III). Talking to the target only repeats a line until the guards are beaten. The monster sits about (-35, +50) from this corner.

Explore.TrackingIcon.doc: Target icon on the map's quest tracker panel; tap to toggle Tracking On/Off. It moves sideways with the quest title's length. Yellow when on, grey when off.

Explore.NpcAlert.doc: Red '!' bubble over an NPC with something to say. Quests can be gated behind talking to them (e.g. the Chief on Originisle V guards the loot row until spoken to). The player's own character also shows one; sxs/explore.py skips the one over the player's name.

Explore.TrackerGift.doc: Gift icon at the right end of the quest tracker panel when a quest is finished; tapping it claims the reward (tapping the text does not always). Same on home and on the map.
